records.title: Overcoming contextless web markup text translation: A parallel and selective Q&A-driven LLM approach
records.reason: The primary article uses selective spans, parallelism, and cache reuse to improve LLM throughput.
records.abstract_evidence_excerpt: Over the past three decades, the web has evolved into a vast repository of knowledge. However, language barriers still prevent many users from accessing foreign-language websites. While modern browsers provide built-in translation, they often ignore page-level context and therefore produce misleading output, degrading user experience. Although processing the full HTML document with a Seq2Seq translation would restore context, it makes inference too slow for real-time browsing.

records.title: Hardware Lifecycle-Aware Power Planning in Commercial Hyperscale Datacenters (Operational Systems)
records.reason: OSDI describes lifecycle-aware hyperscale rack power budgets and prediction deployed across heterogeneous fleets.
records.abstract_evidence_excerpt: Modern commercial datacenters operate with heterogeneous hardware, deploying new servers to meet the growing compute demands while retaining older servers due to budgetary and environmental constraints. Datacenter planners can use daily performance and power profiling data to continually refine power budgets for legacy hardware. By contrast, power planning for new hardware must begin as early as the pre-silicon stage of server development when such data is not yet available.
